name: Dining chair, Vitra Eames DSR

clearance.note: Room behind the chair to pull it out from the table and sit down (the seat faces the table)

notes: Vitra Eames Plastic Side Chair RE DSR (design Charles & Ray Eames, 1950): shell in deep black, Eiffel wire base powder-coated basic dark. W 46.5 × D 55 × H 83 cm, seat height 43 cm, as listed by Vitra dealers (AmbienteDirect, Innes). model.glb is generated by `npx tsx tools/models/dining-chair-eames-dsr.ts` from its own geometry, fitted to Vitra's dimension drawing (front and side view, within about 0.5 cm) and checked against dealer photos: the one-piece moulded shell, a seat with a short waterfall lip that falls gently towards the back and bends up in a radius of about 11 cm into a back standing almost upright (7–10° from vertical), narrowing steadily without a waist to a domed top whose edge curls back, wrapping around the sitter, with rolled edges; on the Eiffel wire base. The collision parts follow the seat, the curved backrest and the base, so the seat slides under a table top. The clearance zone is the room behind the chair to pull it out from a table.
